La 5e de Couv' est un podcast entièremen: La 5e de Couv' is a podcast entirely devoted to the world of manga and Japanese culture. Each episode dives into publishing news, favourites and trends in the Japanese comics market in France. A format that mixes passion, expertise and accessibility for fans and the curious alike.
Pour son tout premier épisode, MediaCrit: For its very first episode, MediaCritic takes on an ambitious niche podcast. Alex and Lolo examine the editorial structure, the quality of the writing and the format's ability to reach a broad audience without betraying its community. A founding episode that lays the groundwork for the MediaCritic method: substance, form, intentions.
